label: Particular: Vocabulary.Particular marks the bearers in the selected reading
definition: Vocabulary.Particular marks the bearers in the selected reading. It does not definitionally exclude Forms, preventing a disputed distinction from being proved by typing.
note: Semantic interface for the bounded issue #257 readings. Primary passages motivate this sense but do not define this modern relational encoding. A sourced replacement would need a passage fixing precisely these semantic boundaries.
